create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
set_and_get_graph_weights: set and get graph arc weights using lists, numpy arrays, or raw pointers
test_scalar_graph_operations: test scalar graph operations like negate, add, and subtract on GTN graphs
run_autograd_backward_pass: run backward pass on GTN graphs to compute gradients with optional retain graph
test_parallel_graph_operations: test parallel operations on lists of GTN graphs using gtn.parallel_for
